reviews.content: I've had 5 children, and I used an older version of this book with every single pregnancy! I thought the information was educational, and extremely beneficial. And, as a mom who DID have some complications during my pregnancies, I valued the information in this book! I've given it as a gift to expectant moms for years, and those moms have gone on to give it to others. If this book wasn't GREAT, it wouldn't have stood the test of time! I'm ordering this version right now as a gift and I'm confident it will be as well received by this new expectant mom, as all the moms I've given it to before her. . After reading some of the negative comments about this book, I'm at a loss as to what those reviewers are taking offense to, to be honest. I was honored to be bringing new life into my family, and I wanted to give my babies the very best start to their lives. This book encouraged me in that goal!
